stable.headline: Save writes over the file, the window title follows the scene, Open with from Explorer, and notifications for long jobs.
notes: Save (Ctrl+S) writes over the file without asking; Save scene as is Ctrl+Shift+S.
The window title is the scene's name, with a diamond while changes are not saved.
MeshOptimiser can be chosen in Explorer's Open with list (the installer adds it).
Settings > General > Notifications: a notification when a long job ends in the background.
A running task shows as a tab on the status bar; the Properties card folds.
Material names of an FBX are kept.
Objects with objects under them (Cinema 4D) open as groups, and file pivots are on the parts.
A part in a turned group reads its rotation from the group's axes.
The Heatmap no longer glows; Remove lettering finds marks on large parts.
